caption: The drawing features three distinct objects arranged near the center of a plain, light-colored background. The topmost object is a folding knife with a metallic, cross-hatched blade and a brown handle, positioned with the blade pointing upwards and to the right. Below and to the left of the knife is a rectangular matchbox with a predominantly brown and tan design, showing part of a label and a metallic end. The third object, below the knife and slightly to the right, is another rectangular box with a grayish or silver appearance, displaying the text "William Sumother" in cursive script across the top. The overall composition is minimal, with the objects separated from each other and ample empty space surrounding them.
title: Pocket Manicure
